Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Belia Keshel: 37-year-old woman, 178 cm (tall), sturdy stocky construction with a broad frame and compact proportions, skin value band-3-light-medium. Face: broad oval face; large hooded eyes and a broken brow line; broad low bridge, full lips; one cheek mole. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: black, bob-pageboy, deliberate accent: sharply stepped fringe. Wardrobe: short-jacket-trousers, specifically a shaped short jacket, practical closures, generous trousers, and low boots; low-profile toggles and articulated knee folds; bounded palette teal-brown. Visible personal details: three hair rings; a repaired cuff with bright thread. Make stitching, quilting, embroidery, or woven pattern the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: severe grooming softened by one unruly feature. Color treatment: uses high-contrast lining visible only in motion. Pose cue: torso angles three-quarter while both arms hang in deliberate asymmetric ease. Include a travel tally cord only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance.
